description: This file contains the implementation of the QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware class, which is responsible for inspecting and casting input parameters of AWS service commands to their modeled types, specifically for query-compatible services transitioning from query to JSON protocols.

classes.name: QueryCompatibleInputMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that inspects command input values and casts them to their modeled types for AWS services using query-compatible protocols.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for a given AWS Service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a handler and a service.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, processes input parameters based on service operation shapes, and passes control to the next handler.

methods.name: processInput
methods.description: Recursively inspects and possibly casts an input value based on its shape type.

methods.name: processStructure
methods.description: Processes structure-typed inputs by inspecting each member.

methods.name: processList
methods.description: Processes list-typed inputs by inspecting each list element.

methods.name: processMap
methods.description: Processes map-typed inputs by inspecting each key-value pair.

methods.name: processScalar
methods.description: Processes scalar inputs, casting them to their modeled type if necessary.

methods.name: changeValueAtPath
methods.description: Modifies a value within the command input at a specified path.

methods.name: isModeledType
methods.description: Checks if a value matches the expected type.

methods.name: castValue
methods.description: Casts a value to the specified modeled type.
